text: Paper · COLM 2024 · arXiv 2312.00752 Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces (Mamba) Albert Gu, Tri Dao (equal contribution, listed alphabetically) Carnegie Mellon University (Gu), Princeton University (Dao) · December 2023 (arXiv v1 1 December 2023; v2 31 May 2024, with the same numbers in every table) In one line: Made SSM parameters (B, C, delta) input-dependent, breaking LTI so the model selectively remembers or forgets per token, and paired it with a fused parallel-scan GPU kernel; in the paper's scaling runs (the Pile, 125M to 1.3B) the first attention-free model to match Transformer++ perplexity, with linear-time training and 5x generation throughput, seeding today's hybrid attention-SSM production models.
